== Problem ==

Buffalo Shuffle-o is a card game in which all the cards are distributed evenly among all players at the start of the game. When Annika and 3 of her friends play Buffalo Shuffle-o, each player is dealt 15 cards. Suppose 2 more friends join the next game. How many cards will be dealt to each player?


<imath>\textbf{(A)}\ 8 \qquad \textbf{(B)}\ 9 \qquad \textbf{(C)}\ 10 \qquad \textbf{(D)}\ 11 \qquad \textbf{(E)}\ 12</imath>

== Solution 1 ==

We start with Annika and <imath>3</imath> of her friends playing, meaning that there are <imath>4</imath> players. This must mean that there is a total of <imath>4 \cdot 15 = 60</imath> cards. If <imath>2</imath> more players joined, there would be <imath>6</imath> players, and since the cards need to be split evenly, this would mean that each player gets <imath>\frac{60}{6}=\boxed{\text{(C)\ 10}}</imath> Buffalo Shuffle-O cards each meaning that the final answer is 10.
